goal_intent: work out whether to eat here this weekend, then book if it suits

turns.utterance: Hi there, I’m thinking of bringing a few friends out for a meal this weekend and wanted to know if your place is good for groups. We’re hoping for something relaxed, maybe with a bit of space to chat.
That’s great to hear, thanks! There’ll be five of us—everyone’s pretty excited for a catch-up over good food.
We were looking at Sunday, since it’s a bit easier for everyone and the weather’s meant to be lovely. Does that work for you?
We were thinking about 6:30pm, so it’s not too late and we have time to linger if we want. Is that a good slot for your team?
Thanks for checking! No allergies or dietary needs for this group, we’re all pretty easygoing eaters. You can book it under Marcus Bell.
Perfect, thanks so much! We’re looking forward to it and I’ll let everyone know. Have a great day! [END OF CALL]
